title: A Secret Agent Catches The Killer Of His Fiancee . . . Then Lets Him Go (I Saw the Devil)
caption:
He caught the man who murdered his fiancee... and let him go on purpose 😳 I Saw the Devil (2010), the whole story. Follow for more movie recaps!

#isawthedevil #koreanmovie #movierecap #thriller #revenge #recap #fyp
comment: Was Daniel right to let the killer live just to make him suffer? 👀 Comment below 👇

segments.say: A secret agent finally catches the man who *murdered* his fiancee. Then he does something crazy. He lets him *go*.
To see how it got here, go back to one snowy *night*.
Emma is stuck on a dark road with a flat *tire*. She calls her fiance, Daniel, who is working late.
A stranger stops to help. He seems *friendly*.
His name is Victor, and he is a *serial killer*. Emma has no idea.
Daniel is far away at work. When he tries to call her back, nobody *answers*.
Her father, Chief Brown, is a retired police chief. He rushes to the scene, and cannot believe what he *sees*.
Daniel arrives too late. He just stands there in the *cold*.
Chief Brown is broken. I was a detective for thirty years, he says, and I could not protect my own *daughter*.
At the funeral, he whispers a *promise*.

segments.text: I promise you this. I'll make him pay for your pain.

segments.say: He asks his boss for two weeks *off*. Then he sneaks out a tiny *tracker*.
It holds a GPS and a *microphone*. Swallow it, and you can be followed and *heard*.
Chief Brown hands him the police files. Four *suspects*, all accused before.
Daniel hunts down the first one. He beats the man so hard that he confesses to the *police*.
The next name is Victor, a school van *driver*. Daniel pretends to be an insurance man and visits his *parents*.
They hate their own son. He left his family long ago, and he never *looked back*.
Meanwhile, Victor is already choosing his next *girl*.
He drives the other kids home first. Then he takes one girl to an empty *field*.
But Daniel has been following. He finds Victor at *last*.
Victor is tough, but Daniel is *stronger*. The fight ends in seconds.
Then Daniel makes him swallow the *capsule*, and walks away.
Victor does not know what he swallowed. He only knows that someone is *hunting* him.
Why not hand him to the police? Because Daniel wants him to *suffer*.
Victor limps away and jumps into a *taxi*.
The driver and the passenger are killers too. They think he is an easy *victim*.
Victor smiles. You said we are lucky? No. You are damn *unlucky*.
Bleeding, he staggers into a small *clinic*.
There he corners a young nurse. Nobody can *stop* him.
Then the door opens. It is Daniel. He was tracking him the *whole time*.

segments.text: Remember... Your nightmare's only getting worse.

segments.say: Daniel saves the nurse and beats Victor again. But once more, he lets him *live*.
Daniel is never loud. He is calm and cold, and he just keeps *coming*.
Chief Brown calls Daniel. Please *stop*, he says. You have done enough.
Emma's sister, Anna, begs him too. She keeps looking *back*, afraid she is being followed.

segments.text: Whatever you do to punish him, things won't change. Revenge is for movies.

segments.say: Daniel says this is not *pointless*, and hangs up.
Hurt and hunted, Victor hides at his old friend Mark's *house*. Mark is a killer, just like him.
They laugh about the man hunting them. Mark says, you created a *monster*.
What they do not know is that Daniel hears every *word*.
Daniel waits outside in the dark, listening, until he has heard *enough*.
Late that night, Daniel breaks in.
It is a wild, ugly fight. Daniel is alone against *two*.
In the end, everyone is knocked *out cold*.
Two days later, Daniel wakes in a hospital. His boss, Ross, says they were both *out*.
Everyone is afraid he is becoming a *monster* to fight a monster.
Ross is a good man. He wants Daniel to rest, and to let the *law* take over.
Daniel says, it feels like a huge rock is on my chest. I promised Emma he would feel the same *pain*.
Then Victor calls him, just to *brag*.
He knows Emma's name. He says she begged for her life, and told him she was *pregnant*.
Daniel did not know. Something inside him *breaks*.
Victor says he will turn himself in today. But first, he has one more *job*.
Mark lies in a hospital bed, smiling. First your girl, he says, then her *family*.
Daniel understands. Emma's family is *next*. He runs.
He phones the house. It rings and rings. Nobody *answers*.
Victor gets there first. Emma's family pays a terrible *price*.
Daniel arrives too late. The police blame *him*.
Victor calls him, just to laugh. Who do you think *won*?
Then he does what he promised. He walks up to the *police*.
But Daniel is already there. He steals Victor from the police, and drives *away*.
Nobody knows where they are. Not the police. Not Ross. Not *anyone*.
In a quiet room, Daniel says, okay, you were right. I made a mistake. I *underestimated* you.

segments.text: I'll kill you at your most painful moment.

segments.say: Victor screams, kill me now! Daniel says, not *yet*.
Now it is Victor who begs for his *life*. Daniel only asks, you have heard that many times, haven't you?
Daniel keeps asking, are you scared? Say it. Do you finally *understand* what you did?
But Victor will not break. You already lost, he says. I do not know *fear*.
Daniel answers, I hope you suffer even after you *die*.
Then comes a knock. Victor's own family is at the *door*.
Don't open the door! Victor screams. For the first time, he is truly *afraid*.
Daniel walks out into the cold. His revenge is *done*.
But Emma is still gone. He got his revenge, so why does it feel like he *lost*?
